instruction: Populate res://scenes/main.tscn so Main contains a water depth visualization scene: add a WorldEnvironment with a procedural sky and glow enabled, a DirectionalLight3D with shadows enabled, a MeshInstance3D named Water that uses a 10x10 PlaneMesh subdivided 20x20 with a ShaderMaterial pointing at res://scenes/WaterShader.tres, a Background Node3D holding exactly 5 sphere MeshInstance3Ds at these positions (all within the 10x10 water plane): Sphere at (2.600, -0.500, -4.500); Sphere2 at (-4.300, 0.200, 3.400); Sphere3 at (4.500, 0.400, 0.900); Sphere4 at (-1.200, -0.100, -3.900); Sphere5 at (0.700, 0.300, 4.600), all with green StandardMaterial3D overrides, and add a Camera3D so all spheres are visible Set the Camera3D FOV to 30 and set the camera Y position to 1.0.
